content.comment_body: In the [product_name] software, is it possible to customize the block colours? For example, having all outputs in one colour, inputs in another, and other functions in a third. I am aware you can adjust marker line colours and the background, but I haven't located an option to change block appearance.
I believe there isn't an option to modify the block colours in [product_name].

Could this feature be considered for future updates? It would be valuable to have the ability to change block colours, particularly for distinguishing inputs and outputs. Also, having more control over the colours and widths of connecting lines would help emphasize main data flows. At present, I resort to printing diagrams and highlighting them manually.

analysis.insight_summary: Users note that the lack of block colour customization in [product_name] makes organizing and clarifying diagrams more difficult. Although it's possible to adjust marker lines and backgrounds, blocks themselves remain unchangeable, leading to less effective visual distinction and forcing users to use manual highlighter pens on printed copies for emphasis.
analysis.user_expectations: Users would like more options for customizing block colours to clarify diagrams and highlight important data flows, along with better controls for line appearance.
